Texto PDF extraído com PyMuPDF; página digitalizada é submetida a OCR por Tesseract por+eng; byte original é arquivado antes da leitura.
Relações oficiais vides registradas no histórico sem atribuir diff nem vigência que o portal não prova.

findings: O portal SAPL se identifica como Câmara Municipal de Manaus no domínio cmm.am.gov.br; link cruzado a partir da página raiz institucional não foi verificado nesta coleta.
API paginada com 9.846 normas, page_size=100 funcional, 99 páginas e 12 tipos normativos.
Registros confirmam esfera_federacao=M e publicam texto_integral em /media/sapl/public/normajuridica/.
Lei Ordinária 115/1949: API detalhada e PDF de 439.668 bytes; extração local resultou em 2.161 bytes de texto legível.
Rotas normarelacionada aceitam filtros norma_principal e norma_relacionada; tipo_vinculo fornece o tipo de relação oficial.
Adapter de catálogo, identity check, PDF/OCR, histórico relacional e backfill por lote implementados nesta branch; produção aguarda release.

Official homepage links to SAPL and its municipal legislation consultation.
Official homepage links to the SAPL portal.

validation.json_and_pagination: All six APIs returned HTTP 200 JSON, stable page totals, typed records and same-host source URLs on page 1.
validation.document_fetch: One source-published PDF from each of Unaí, São João da Boa Vista and Natal was fetched and its stated type, number and year were identity-checked.
validation.federation_scope: SAPL exposes M (municipal), E (state), F (federal) and older blank values. The adapter preserves declared scope and counts records by scope; blank scope uses the verified municipal source as the jurisdiction basis.
validation.limits: The five new catalogs were not yet fully enumerated in Railway at this research snapshot. Source API totals are not a national completeness denominator; sync completion must be read from production SourceRegistry and /api/stats.
validation.local_ocr: This workspace lacks Portuguese Tesseract traineddata; Railway Docker installs por traineddata. Text-level OCR validation for scanned PDFs therefore belongs to the deployed worker.

limitations: Local source totals are isolated-database validations; production counts must be obtained after deploy.
The Brazilian national set has no demonstrated single official endpoint enumerating all federal, state, DF and municipal laws.
The LexML SRU route probed returned anti-automation challenge HTML; direct ALESP and SINJ adapters do not depend on it.
SINJ-DF records without a declared text attachment require investigation in official gazettes or other official repositories.
Source relations do not guarantee prior/current full wording or legal-effective date for each provision.
The Normas.leg.br classification remains non-official where the provider says so; parser success is not a legal completeness certificate.

No single national official endpoint has been demonstrated for all jurisdictions; the six verified SAPL municipalities cover only a small fraction of local legislatures, and each new source family still requires confirmation and integration.
